description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of an underworld meadow: dark lush grass that never withers, a few tiny pale flowers, a faint green glow from the ground between the blades, muted very dark palette of deep green, black and dull gold, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
